description: We are Astronaut's Stalker, competing in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge! Our goal is to develop an AI-powered, data-driven decision-support tool that combines NASA Earth observations, local soil data, and crop characteristics to recommend sustainable crop rotation strategies. We aim to help farmers adapt to climate change, optimize water use, improve soil health, and build more resilient agricultural systems.
summary:
AgriOrbit was developed as an intelligent, interactive agricultural decision-support and farm simulation platform specifically designed for Egypt. It integrates interactive farm management, synchronized 2D GIS and 3D farm visualization, an Egyptian crop knowledge database, soil/water/irrigation/history tracking, NASA Earth-observation intelligence, scientific crop suitability analysis, multi-season crop rotation optimization, an interactive 3D simulation environment, a bilingual (English/Arabic, RTL-correct) Farmer's Academy, and scientific report generation.
It bridges field-level farming with rigorous scientific data by linking actual farm and plot boundaries to NASA Earth-observation products, running deterministic scientific suitability evaluations, and using constraint-based optimization (OR-Tools CP-SAT) to generate multi-season crop rotation strategies.
It provides professional GIS and agricultural decision-support tools tailored for Egyptian farmers and advisers. It maintains strict technical depth behind progressive disclosure to keep the experience simple for everyday users, enforces a strict "Data Gate" rule that prevents fabricated science or unverified data, and treats Arabic as a first-class language rather than a translation afterthought.
details:
AgriOrbit is an interactive agricultural platform designed for Egypt that combines farm management, 2D mapping, and 3D simulations. It runs on a Node.js backend for general operations and uses a Python library (agri_engine) to handle scientific calculations like crop suitability and rotation planning.

The platform prioritizes transparency by labeling every data point with a specific evidence class. Through its strict "Data Gate" rule, it prevents fabricated information, keeping features disabled until verified datasets are provided.

Built on a modern web stack featuring React, TypeScript, MapLibre, and Three.js, AgriOrbit includes creative features such as custom 3D models for various crops and a synchronized studio where edits on the 2D map instantly update the 3D view.

Key design considerations for the project include first-class Arabic and right-to-left (RTL) support, performance quality tiers for different devices, and robust security and data privacy safeguards.
